description: This source file provides utility functions and classes for image processing tasks including image format conversion, template matching, non-max suppression, and drawing detection boxes. It is part of an image analysis or object detection module.

classes.name: Detection

methods.name: np.ndarray pil_to_cv(img: Image.Image)

methods.description: Clamps rectangle coordinates within image boundaries.

methods.name: List[Detection] nms(detections: List[Detection], iou_threshold: float = 0.3)

methods.name: np.ndarray _to_gray_preproc(img_bgr: np.ndarray)
methods.description: Preprocesses an image for template matching by converting to grayscale, applying histogram normalization and Gaussian blur.

methods.name: List[Detection] multi_scale_template_match( image_bgr: np.ndarray, templates_bgr: List[np.ndarray], match_threshold: float = 0.8, scales: List[float] | None = None, method: int = cv2.TM_CCOEFF_NORMED, )
methods.description: Performs multi-scale template matching using robust preprocessing techniques, returning detection boxes.

methods.name: np.ndarray draw_boxes(img_bgr: np.ndarray, boxes: List[Detection], color=(0, 0, 255), thickness: int = 2)
methods.description: Draws detection boxes on an image, returning the annotated image.
